name: claim_slot_for_request
description: Rejects a zero request, a request above 64, and one whose key matches an entry already in use. Otherwise it selects a free slot, stores the caller's values together with a fixed count of 200, records the chosen slot number, calls helpers, and writes the outcome back to the caller's block.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:3:079A
name: select_slot_and_fill_request
description: Chooses one of four slots by comparing stored thresholds and records the slot number in a global. It fills that slot's fields with the caller's values and a fixed count of 200, then stores the returned status or sets one of four global flags by status code.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:3:07AC
name: select_slot_if_within_limit
description: Chooses a slot by comparing stored thresholds and returns without action when the input value is below the smallest of them. Otherwise it fills the slot fields, calls helpers and records the returned status in the same way as its neighbours.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:3:07D2
name: select_slot_and_write_request
description: Chooses a slot in a fixed priority order, using the first slot directly when it is free. It writes the caller's values into that slot's fields with a fixed count of 200, calls helpers, and stores the returned status word.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:3:07F2
name: pick_slot_and_write_fields
description: Selects a slot from stored thresholds and returns early when the input is below the threshold. Otherwise it writes the request fields with a fixed count of 200, calls helpers, and stores the result status.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:3:0812
name: pick_slot_by_threshold_compare
description: Picks one of four slots by comparing the input value and stored thresholds, with a fallback slot when none qualifies. It then fills the request fields, calls helpers, and records the returned status.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:3:0832
name: pick_slot_when_above_threshold
description: Selects a slot by comparing stored thresholds and only proceeds when the input value is at least the chosen threshold. It then writes the request fields, calls helpers, and sets a status flag from the returned code.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:3:089A
name: send_request_store_status
description: Writes the caller's values and a fixed count of 200 into a request block, calls helpers, and stores the returned status. When the status is the all-ones value it clears the caller's block instead.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:3:08DE
name: record_status_and_set_flag
description: Stores the status word into the block's status field, then sets one of four global flags according to the status value 4, 3 or 2, with the fourth flag used for all other values. It finally clears the shared busy flag.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:3:0906
name: set_flag_for_status_code
description: Sets one of three global status flags according to the data register value (3, 2, or any other value), clearing the others. It then clears the shared busy flag.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:3:0920
name: set_flag_for_status_two
description: Sets one of two global status flags according to whether the data register holds 2, clearing the other, and then clears the shared busy flag.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:3:093A
name: reset_global_flags
description: Sets one global flag to zero, another to one and clears the shared busy flag. The code shows no helper call, so the routine does only these three assignments.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:3:0954
name: call_helpers_and_clear_flag
description: Calls two helper routines in sequence and then clears the shared busy flag. The body contains no other work.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:3:0964
name: mark_block_active_and_store
description: Sets the first word of the caller's block to one, clears one of three status flags selected by the block's status field, then stores the data and address register values into the block and zeroes its final word.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:3:097E
name: clear_three_way_flag_store
description: Clears a global flag chosen from the block's status field (4, 3, or any other value), then stores the data and address register values into the block and zeroes its final word.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:3:0990
name: clear_two_way_flag_store
description: Clears one of two global flags depending on whether the data register holds 2, otherwise clears a different flag, then stores the register values into the caller's block and zeroes its final word.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:3:09A4
name: clear_flag_then_store_regs
description: Clears a global flag, then stores the data and address register values into the caller's block with the first word set to one and the final word set to zero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:3:09AA
name: store_regs_to_block
description: Stores the contents of several data registers and an address register into a memory block pointed to by an input pointer, setting the first word to one and the last to zero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:3:09C8
name: set_audio_channel_if_free
description: Selects an audio channel register set by the block's status field and checks that channel's busy flag. If the channel is busy it clears the block's fields; otherwise it writes two block words to that channel's volume and period registers.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:3:09CE
name: set_audio_channel_data
description: Checks a global flag for the audio channel selected by the status value, and when the channel is free writes volume and period words from the block into the channel's hardware registers. A busy channel causes the block to be cleared instead.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:3:0ABE

description: Clears a block of word globals, then writes the constants one to eight into eight other globals. description: Advances a playback control block by one tick: when its counter is zero it reads the next entry from a list and loads the entry's value and parameters, otherwise it decrements the counter. It then adjusts a level value over time, writes the resulting word to an output pointer and moves that pointer forward; the routine is dispatched on the entry value, and it also calls a helper.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:3:14EE

description: Stores the first input word as the block's counter, points its entry list at the global buffer, and clears one output word. It then writes the next output word using the same level-adjusted logic as the sequence stepper.

description: Clears bit one of a shared status word, then loads the next input entry into the control block, returning without loading when the entry value is zero. It then stores the shared word and writes the next output word.

description: Sets bit one of a shared status word, then loads the next input entry into the control block, returning without loading when the entry value is zero. It then stores the shared word and writes the next output word.

description: Reads a pointer from the input block and copies the entry's mode and parameter longs into the control block, using a shorter copy when the mode is zero. It then loads the next entry's value and parameters and writes the next output word.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:3:15DC
name: load_entry_from_pointer_list
description: Takes the next entry pointer from a list that wraps back to its start, returning when that entry value is zero. Otherwise it loads the entry's value and parameters into the control block and writes the next output word.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:3:15F6

description: Copies a long value from the input into the control block and points its output list at the next word. It then loads the entry the same way as its neighbours, returning immediately when the entry value is zero.
